Add Pain Relief to Your Practice

Your practice members trust you. Now you can solve their biggest complaint, without changing what you do.

The Problem You See Every Day

Your practice members come to you with pain. Maybe it's a yoga student who can't get into a forward fold. A training practice member whose shoulder won't let them press. A coaching practice member who says "I'd exercise more if my back didn't hurt."

You do your best, but structural pain isn't your lane. You refer them out, and half the time they don't follow through, or they bounce between providers without results.

What if you could solve it for them?

How the Partnership Works

Three steps. No complexity.

1. Experience It Yourself

We start by gifting you a complimentary session so you feel the results firsthand. No pitch, no pressure. Just letting the work speak for itself.

2. Offer It to Your Practice Members

Set your own price, bundle it with your services, or offer it standalone. You charge your practice members directly and keep 100% of what they pay you.

3. We Handle Everything

Submit your practice member's info through our referral portal. We reach out, book the session, deliver the session, and handle all follow-up.

You Set the Price. You Keep Every Dollar.

This isn't a referral fee. You're adding a premium service to your offering, and you control the economics.

Your cost is $225 per session. That's the floor. What you charge your practice members is entirely up to you. Pass it through at cost to build trust. Mark it up as a premium referral. Bundle it into your own packages. The margin is yours to set.

Partners who bundle Amari Method sessions into their existing services, like personal training packages, wellness programs, and coaching intensives, consistently see the highest practice member retention and the best margins.

Example: "3 personal training sessions + 1 Amari Method pain relief session." Your practice member sees one package, one price, one solution. You keep everything above your $225 cost.

What Your Practice Members Get

The Amari Method is a hands-on, 60-minute alignment session with Garrett. Practice Members learn exactly what's creating their pain and leave with specific tools to maintain their own relief.

Results That Speak

  • Practice Members canceling scheduled surgeries
  • Chronic issues resolved permanently
  • Tools they keep for life
  • 4.9/5 from 200+ practice members

What You're NOT Responsible For

  • Delivering the session (that's us)
  • Follow-up or upselling (that's us)
  • The results (that's us)
  • Scheduling or logistics (that's us)
